title: Asynchronous asset load finalization on GameThread
fix_rationale: The trace shows PostLoad or package import/export finalization occurred on the GameThread as an asynchronous load completed. Heavy UObject initialization in PostLoad blocks the main thread.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms on the GameThread ({share}% of excess time) finalizing asynchronously loaded assets.

fixes.text: Audit C++ and Blueprint PostLoad implementations to eliminate synchronous disk reads, complex calculations, or actor registrations.
Stagger asset load completions across multiple frames by batching async load requests.
Move asset finalization and procedural generation to background tasks where possible.

verify: Re-capture the trace and confirm that PostLoad execution time on the GameThread decreases.
caveats: PostLoad executes on the GameThread even when packages are loaded asynchronously by the async loading thread.
